.dist/plugin/bundle.json

# And what it does not. The skill would have found nothing, which reads to a user exactly like a term
# the corpus does not define.

# The hook goes the same way, and takes the breadcrumb with it. A breadcrumb is rendered beside the
# hook that prints it, so a corpus with nothing to say says nothing rather than announcing at every
# session that it holds no terms.
!.dist/plugin/hooks/hooks.json
!.dist/plugin/hooks/breadcrumb
